nvitk.db.importers
==================

.. py:module:: nvitk.db.importers

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Curated and PESA-brain import pipelines: spreadsheets, cohort membership, measurement upserts.

   Functions return DataFrames or call :class:`~nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo` writers; CLI is optional via ``click``.

.. py:function:: _resolve_import_pipeline_id(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, modality: str) -> str | None

   Prefer ``NVITK_PIPELINE_ID_<MODALITY>`` or ``NVITK_PIPELINE_ID``, else catalog default for modality.


.. py:function:: _cli_decorator(*args, **kwargs)

   No-op stand-in for ``click.command``/``click.option`` when click isn't installed.

   :value: ['visit_id', 'visit', 'visit_label', 'visit_number', 'visita']


.. py:data:: SESSION_CANDIDATES
   :value: ['session_uid', 'session_id', 'mri_id', 'mr id', 'experiment_label', 'session']


.. py:data:: DATE_CANDIDATES
   :value: ['date', 'imagingdate', 'measured_at', 'scan_date', 'session_date', 'psqdate_reconocimiento_medico']


.. py:function:: _image_measurement_session_id_series(raw: pandas.DataFrame) -> pandas.Series

   Return a per-row session id for ``image_measurements`` with a stable empty-string sentinel.

   Subject-only Excel sheets have no session column. Using ``pd.NA`` for every row makes
   ``drop_duplicates`` / merges treat rows inconsistently after Parquet round-trips, which
   shows up as duplicated subjects. Missing or blank session is stored as ``""``.


.. py:function:: _column_name_is_timeseries_frame_index(name: object) -> bool

   True if a column label is a non-negative integer frame index (0, 1, 2 or 0.0, '3', …).


.. py:function:: _timeseries_wide_frame_columns(all_columns: list, *, reserved: set[str]) -> list

   Frame-index columns (e.g. per-timepoint ``0``, ``1``, ...) among *all_columns*, excluding *reserved* names.

   Look up registered :class:`SourceSpec` entries for *filename*, optionally filtered by sheet/kind.

   Generate a timestamped default batch id (``pesabrain_<UTC timestamp>``).

   True when a column name looks like a subject/session identifier (by suffix or known prefix).


.. py:function:: _measurement_skip_columns(raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, domain: str) -> set[Any]

   Columns to exclude when melting wide measurement sheets into long form.

   Cohort-membership source label for a spec (``pesabrain:<batch_id>``).

   Build a synthetic (non-XNAT) session uid from a subject and visit label.

   Normalize a raw region/vessel name into a canonical variable-id-style region id.


.. py:function:: read_tabular_source(path: str | pathlib.Path, *, sheet_name: str | int = 0, header: int = 0) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Read a tabular source file (Excel or CSV) by extension into a DataFrame.


.. py:function:: list_excel_sources(base_path: str | pathlib.Path) -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Sorted list of Excel files directly under *base_path*.


.. py:function:: _normalized_column_map(columns: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]

   Map alphanumeric-only lowercased column names back to their original names.


.. py:function:: _first_matching_column(df: pandas.DataFrame, candidates: list[str]) -> str | None

   First column in *df* matching any of *candidates* by normalized (alphanumeric, lowercased) name.


.. py:function:: _parse_datetime_series(series: pandas.Series) -> pandas.Series

   Parse a column as datetimes, auto-detecting Excel serial date numbers (values in the 20000-60000 range).


.. py:function:: _coerce_numeric(series: pandas.Series) -> pandas.Series

   Coerce a column to float64, retrying with comma-decimal normalization if the first pass finds no numbers.


.. py:function:: _series_value_payload(series: pandas.Series) -> tuple[pandas.Series, pandas.Series, str]

   Split a column into ``(numeric_values, text_values, value_kind)``, classifying it numeric if ≥70% parses as a number.


.. py:function:: ensure_subject_uid(df: pandas.DataFrame, *, candidates: list[str] | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Ensure *df* has a ``subject_uid`` column: reuse it if present, else derive it from a matching id column,
   else synthesize row-index placeholder ids.


.. py:function:: _source_table_name(source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str) -> str

   Build a stable ``<file stem>::<sheet>`` table identifier.


.. py:function:: _inventory_row(source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, df: pandas.DataFrame, spec: SourceSpec, source_batch_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]

   Build one ``source_tables`` inventory row describing an imported sheet.


.. py:function:: _register_inventory_rows(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Upsert a batch of ``source_tables`` inventory rows into the repo.


.. py:function:: _variable_entry(*, variable_id: str, source_column: str, domain: str, table: str, modality: str | None = None, value_kind: str | None = None, label: str | None = None, source_file: str | None = None, source_sheet: str | None = None, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]

   Build one ``variables`` dictionary row for a single imported column.


.. py:function:: _upsert_subject_ids(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, df: pandas.DataFrame) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Upsert a ``subject_ids`` frame into the repo (no-op for an empty frame).


.. py:function:: _upsert_sessions(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, df: pandas.DataFrame) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Upsert a ``sessions`` frame into the repo (no-op for an empty frame).


.. py:function:: harvest_subject_ids_from_frame(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, id_source: str | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Extract every identifier-like column from *raw* into ``subject_ids`` rows and upsert them.


.. py:function:: import_subject_ids_from_source(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, source_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, source_batch_id: str, id_source: str | None = None, sheet_name: str = 'Sheet1') -> pandas.DataFrame

   Load a tabular source and harvest its identifier columns into ``subject_ids``.


.. py:function:: import_cohort_membership_from_source(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, source_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, cohort_id: str, source_batch_id: str, sheet_name: str = 'Sheet1') -> pandas.DataFrame

   Load a tabular source and register every row's subject as a member of *cohort_id*.


.. py:function:: upsert_cohort_membership_for_subjects(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, cohort_id: str, subject_uids: Iterable[str], *, source_batch_id: str, membership_source: str = 'import') -> pandas.DataFrame

   Register ``subject_uid`` values as members of ``cohort_id`` (upserts ``cohort_membership``).


.. py:function:: _collect_subject_uids_from_import_result(result: Any) -> set[str]

   Recursively collect every non-empty ``subject_uid`` value out of a (possibly nested) import result.


.. py:function:: import_measurements_from_source(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, source_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, kind: str, source_batch_id: str, modality: str | None = None, sheet_name: str | int = 0) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Load a tabular source and import it as clinical or image measurements, per *kind*.


.. py:function:: harvest_sessions_from_frame(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, modality: str | None, default_visit_label: str | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Extract session rows (uid, visit, scanner, acquisition date) from *raw* and upsert into ``sessions``.


.. py:function:: _upsert_measurements(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, table_name: str, df: pandas.DataFrame) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Upsert a measurements frame into *table_name* (no-op for an empty frame).


.. py:function:: _register_variables(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, entries: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None

   Register a batch of variable-dictionary entries with the repo (no-op if empty).


.. py:function:: _clinical_frame(raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, visit_column: str | None, date_column: str | None, column: str, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, variable_id: str | None = None, unit: str | None = None, default_visit_label: str | None = None) -> tuple[pandas.DataFrame, dict[str, Any] | None]

   Build one ``clinical_measurements`` long-form frame (and its variable-dictionary entry) for a single wide column.


.. py:function:: _image_frame(raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, session_column: str | None, date_column: str | None, column: str, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, modality: str, variable_id: str, region_id: str | None, region_label: str | None, frame_index: pandas.Series | None = None, unit: str | None = None, pipeline_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[pandas.DataFrame, dict[str, Any] | None]

   Build one ``image_measurements`` long-form frame (and its variable-dictionary entry) for a single wide column.


.. py:function:: _parse_generic_clinical_wide(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, default_visit_label: str | None = None, harvest_sessions: bool = False) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Import a generic wide clinical sheet: harvest subject ids (and optionally sessions), then melt every
   non-identifier column into ``clinical_measurements`` rows and register their variable-dictionary entries.


.. py:function:: _parse_image_wide_column(source_name: str, column: str) -> tuple[str, str | None, str | None]

   File-specific mapping from a wide image column to ``(variable_id, region_id, region_label)``, by known PESA-Brain source name.


.. py:function:: _parse_generic_image_wide(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, modality: str, pipeline_id: str | None = None, harvest_sessions: bool = False) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Import a generic wide image sheet: harvest subject ids (and optionally sessions), then melt every
   non-identifier column into ``image_measurements`` rows, mapping each column via :func:`_parse_image_wide_column`.


.. py:function:: _parse_image_timeseries_long(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, modality: str) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Import a long-form per-frame timeseries sheet (one row per subject×vessel×frame) into ``image_measurements``.


.. py:function:: _parse_image_timeseries_wide(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, modality: str, pipeline_id: str | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Import a wide per-frame timeseries sheet (one column per frame index) into ``image_measurements``, melting frame columns to rows.


.. py:function:: _resolve_metadata_columns(df: pandas.DataFrame) -> dict[str, str | None]

   Map canonical variable-dictionary field names to their matching (Spanish/English) column in *df*.


.. py:function:: _metadata_type_to_value_kind(value: Any) -> str | None

   Map a free-text variable-dictionary type string (Spanish/English) to a canonical value kind.


.. py:function:: _split_allowed_values(value: Any) -> list[str]

   Split a semicolon/pipe-separated allowed-values cell into a clean list of strings.


.. py:function:: _parse_variable_dictionary(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, domain: str, modality: str | None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Parse a variable-dictionary sheet (one row per variable, with description/unit/range metadata) into variable entries.


.. py:function:: _parse_dropdown_dictionary(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, raw: pandas.DataFrame, *, source_path: pathlib.Path, sheet_name: str, source_batch_id: str, domain: str, modality: str | None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Parse a dropdown-value sheet (one column per variable, header = name, rest = allowed values) into variable entries.


.. py:function:: normalize_session_visit_labels(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Set ``sessions.visit_label`` from ``project_id`` (PESA_Brain/local → 4, IA_PET_V5 → 5).


.. py:function:: enrich_sessions_available_scans(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Populate ``sessions.available_scans`` from the ``scans`` table (comma-separated asset slots).


.. py:function:: normalize_measurement_visit_ids(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo) -> None

   Align ``visit_id`` on clinical/cognitive measurements with project/source rules.


.. py:function:: prune_redundant_local_sessions(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Drop ``local_db`` sessions for subjects that already have a non-local session (e.g. XNAT).


.. py:function:: rebuild_subjects_table(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Recompute the ``subjects`` table by collecting every distinct ``subject_uid`` seen across
   ``subject_ids``, ``clinical_measurements``, ``image_measurements`` and ``sessions``, then filling in
   per-subject demographics (primary patient ID, sex, birth date) from ``subject_ids``/``clinical_measurements``.
   Overwrites the existing ``subjects`` table.


.. py:function:: import_source_spec(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, source_path: pathlib.Path, spec: SourceSpec, *, source_batch_id: str, pipeline_id: str | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame | dict[str, pandas.DataFrame]

   Import a single tabular source according to its ``SourceSpec``, logging it in the inventory and
   dispatching to the parser matching ``spec.source_kind`` (subject IDs, cohort membership, subject
   catalog, clinical/image wide tables, image time series, or variable/dropdown dictionaries).


.. py:function:: import_pesabrain_db_directory(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, db_base_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, source_batch_id: str | None = None, build_sqlite_index: bool = False, cohort_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]

   Import every Excel workbook under ``db_base_path`` that has a configured PESA-Brain source spec,
   recording unmapped sheets in the inventory, rebuilding the ``subjects`` table, and enrolling any
   subjects touched by the import into ``cohort_id`` (default cohort if unset). Optionally rebuilds the
   SQLite query cache. Returns a dict of per-sheet import results plus the rebuilt ``subjects`` frame.


.. py:function:: import_pesabrain_source(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, db_base_path: str | pathlib.Path, filename: str, *, sheet: str | None = None, source_kind: str | None = None, source_batch_id: str | None = None, rebuild_subjects: bool = True, build_sqlite_index: bool = False, pipeline_id: str | None = None, cohort_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]

   Import a single named file from ``db_base_path``, resolving it against the configured PESA-Brain
   source specs (optionally narrowed by ``sheet``/``source_kind`` when a filename maps to more than one
   spec). Enrolls any resulting subjects into ``cohort_id`` and, unless ``rebuild_subjects`` is False,
   refreshes the ``subjects`` table. Raises ``FileNotFoundError`` if the directory or file is missing, and
   ``ValueError`` if the filename matches zero or multiple specs.


.. py:function:: import_pesabrain_curated_tables(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, db_base_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, source_batch_id: str | None = None, build_sqlite_index: bool = False, cohort_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]

   Alias for :func:`import_pesabrain_db_directory` kept for call sites that import the "curated"
   (already-cleaned) PESA-Brain table set; the underlying directory-scan logic is identical.


.. py:function:: main(dataset_root: pathlib.Path, db_base_path: pathlib.Path, build_sqlite_index: bool, pipeline_id: str | None) -> None

   CLI entry point: scaffold/open the dataset at ``dataset_root`` and import every configured
   PESA-Brain source found under ``db_base_path`` into it.
